title: Untangle
description: A short path for shame or guilt. You can take responsibility without turning yourself into the punishment.
intro: Which thought feels closer right now?
caution: If guilt is being used to pressure, threaten or control you, pause before contacting anyone. Come back to your body first.
ground_prefix: If this is making you feel more flooded, stop here and

steps.title: Name the feeling, not yourself.
steps.hint: Try: “Shame is here.” Not: “I am shameful.”

steps.title: A painful feeling is not a verdict.
steps.hint: You are more than the moment your mind is replaying.

steps.title: Borrow a kinder voice.
steps.hint: What would you say to someone you care about in this exact situation?

steps.title: Stay on your own side.
steps.hint: You can learn, make amends and grow without abandoning yourself.

shame.complete_heading: You stayed with yourself. That matters.
shame.complete_hint: You can be accountable and still deserve your own care.

steps.title: Name the action precisely.
steps.hint: Keep it specific. Avoid “I always” and “I never.”

steps.title: Responsibility is not punishment.
steps.hint: Guilt can point toward your values. Endless self-attack does not make things right.

steps.title: Choose one proportionate next step.
steps.hint: Apologise, correct, replace, clarify or change a behaviour. You do not have to send anything now.

steps.title: Let the next action carry the lesson.
steps.hint: Make it small, specific and safe. Then allow yourself to stop rehearsing the punishment.

guilt.complete_heading: One honest next step matters more than another hour of punishment.
guilt.complete_hint: Choose the next right action when you are steady enough. Nothing needs to be sent from this screen.
